title: Binding Mochi (Poke Ball Pattern) 095/131 SV: Prismatic Evolutions Pokemon
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Binding Mochi (Poke Ball Pattern) 095/131 SV: Prismatic Evolutions Pokemon card is a sought-after collectible item from the Pokémon TCG series. Manufactured by Pokemon in 2025, this English-language card features illustrations by 5ban Graphics and showcases a holo finish. With a standard card size and made of durable card stock, this uncommon rarity card is a must-have for collectors and fans of popular Pokémon characters like Mewtwo, Pikachu, Charizard, Eevee, Mew, and Regigigas. Perfect for ages 4 and up, this Pokémon tool card is a valuable addition to any collection.
